dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: I've heard that it's become very troublesome to apply for a visit to Inazuma recently. Therefore, I asked a friend from Snezhnaya to help me.

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: I went through much trouble to get the documents ready and came all the way over here with a fleet...

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: In the end, that inspector named Yurika kept saying that I am still missing some "materials," which need to be added on.

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: But I don't get it. Apart from these documents, what else do I still need?
